fields.md:
### 1-1. Primary record (④ launch record, queried 2026-11-15 KST)

| Item | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Status | **'Launch Successful'** · no failreason | ④ [LL2 launch record](https://ll.thespacedevs.com/2.3.0/launches/0f867f0c-5422-4d44-93b8-d7faaae7019b/) |
| Last updated | 2026-11-14 21:23:58 UTC | Same as above |
| Last line of updates | 2026-11-14 21:23 UTC 'Starship Ship 42 has returned to Starbase.' | Same as above |
| Ship landing record | attempt true · **success true** · 'Ship 42 has returned to its launch site at Starbase.' | Same as above |
| Booster landing record | attempt true · success false — aborted before the landing burn; did not attempt a return to the launch site and splashed down in the Gulf of Mexico | Same as above |
| Launch | 2026-11-13 22:47:36 UTC | Same as above |

The LL2 wording for the Ship landing is 'returned'. This record alone does not settle whether it was a tower catch or a ground landing. By definition, however, both fall within the accepted range (source: `state.definitions.ship_recovery`).
